template.title: Analysis template
template.description: A CytoWeave template (.cwt): the gates, tables and figures to apply to every sample. Make one in CytoWeave with Save as a template… and Download (.cwt), then upload it to the project.

sample_metadata.title: Annotate samples with the dataset's sample metadata
sample_metadata.description: Gives each sample the metadata Cirro holds for it (condition, donor, timepoint), for tables and reports grouped by it.

qc.title: Run acquisition QC first
qc.description: Removes unstable stretches of acquisition with a "QC pass" population above the template's.

report.title: Batch report
report.description: The template's last figure for every sample.

report_by.title: Report pages by
report_by.description: One page per sample (sample), or per value of an annotation such as subject. Empty: the figure's own choice.

review.title: Review report (review.html)
review.description: The analysis as one HTML file with every number traced, for a PI or reviewer.

certificate.title: Reproducibility certificate (certificate.acs)
certificate.description: The analysis with its files and every number, for cytoweave verify.
